content.short: Meld aggregates multiple crypto on/off-ramps through a single integration and UI, including MoonPay, Banxa, Sardine, Simplex and Transak.
content.description: Meld enables developers to build a multi-vendor fintech stack with a single integration and UI. Since 2021, it provides access to a broad range of financial integrations across multiple domains with just a few lines of code. Developers can lower third-party vendor costs, increase coverage and conversion rates, and save time by launching integrations across markets faster. Meld aggregates crypto on/off-ramps from MoonPay, Banxa, Sardine, Simplex, Transak, and others through one integration and UI. By combining providers, onboarding spans 225+ countries, 500+ tokens, 110+ currencies, and the largest number of local payment methods.
